identity_check: Confirmed as NowPurchase (nowpurchase.com), the Kolkata-based company founded in 2017; Inc42 Datalabs gives the legal name as BIZ HERO INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED. Entrackr (2022, 2024), Inc42 (2024, 2026), Outlook Business, Entrepreneur India and its LinkedIn page (Kolkata, founded 2017, nowpurchase.com) all describe the same business: a raw-material marketplace and MetalCloud software for metal manufacturers and foundries, run by founder-CEO Naman Shah. Category kept 'adjacent'. Most of the business is selling raw materials (metal scrap, carbon additives, ferro alloys) through a marketplace with its own warehouses and scrap processing centres. It does overlap with Utopian Autonomy's procurement and process-stability agents: buyers get live prices and stock through a WhatsApp bot, and MetalCloud uses AI to optimise the melting process. That overlap is confined to foundries and metal manufacturing, so it is borderline-direct there. Layer set to plant_ops rather than process_planning: MetalCloud optimises the running melt process inside the plant and the marketplace serves plant procurement; neither plans how parts are made.

open_items: Funding before 2022 not found. In Sep 2024 the company said total funds raised were $10M including the $6M round, but the known rounds ($2.4M seed plus $6M) add to $8.4M, leaving about $1.6M unexplained. By April 2026 the company claimed ₹120 Cr in equity to date.
The equity/debt split of the Sep 2024 $6M round is not disclosed. Entrepreneur India names Capsave Finance and UC Inclusive as the debt providers; both are recorded as participants.
The stage of the 2024 and 2026 rounds is not named in the press. Inc42 Datalabs labels both rounds 'Undisclosed' and puts the 2026 round at 'Late Stage'.

Revenue not recorded because no fetched press article reports it. The Inc42 Datalabs profile (a database page) says 'reported revenue of ₹330.5 Cr in FY25, an increase of 74.6% from FY24 (₹189.3 Cr)'. This is mostly raw-material trading revenue, not SaaS. An Entrackr or other press article reporting the MCA filing should be found before the figure is recorded.
Valuations not disclosed for any round.
nowpurchase.com is client-side rendered, and only its title and tagline could be read; product details come from press articles. No public pricing.
Not a funding event: the November 2024 ESOP buyback (Inc42) was valued at about 100x the initial purchase price, and 40 employees cashed out part of their vested options.
Lead investors of the 2022 seed are given as 'Orios' and 'InfoEdge Ventures'. These are taken to be Orios Venture Partners and Info Edge Ventures.

company.description: Kolkata-based raw-material marketplace and AI melt-optimisation software (MetalCloud) for foundries and metal manufacturers.

layer_detail: Two parts. First, a procurement marketplace for metal manufacturers selling metal scrap, carbon additives, ferro alloys and branded products, backed by six warehouses and two scrap processing centres as of Apr 2026, with a WhatsApp bot for real-time prices and stock. Second, MetalCloud, AI SaaS that suggests how to optimise melting and that the company calls the 'core operating system for metal manufacturers'. The LinkedIn page says it is building 'the operating system for metal manufacturing' across procurement, quality and production. Overlaps Utopian Autonomy on procurement and process stability, within foundries and metal plants only.
product_summary: B2B marketplace supplying foundries and metal manufacturers with raw materials (metal scrap, carbon additives, ferro alloys) from its own warehouses and scrap processing centres, plus MetalCloud, AI-based SaaS that suggests melting optimisations; buyers see live prices and stock through a WhatsApp bot.
